events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: A Night of Smoke and Silk at Strasburg Rail Road
events.description: Dearest gentle friends and socialites, You are cordially invited to step back through time to attend “A Night of Smoke and Silk,” hosted by Strasburg Rail Road. This evening’s gala transports our guests to 1871 in lieu of the tragic fire that befell our beloved rail road on January 16 of that year. Esteemed guests, you are encouraged to dress in your finest Victorian era-inspired attire and enjoy a delicious dinner catered by our very own Café 1832. But our gala is soon brought to a screaming halt when a dead body is discovered! We invite you to immerse yourselves in this world and help our witty Detective Punch solve the case of murder. Our first-class train cars will escort you all through the beautiful countryside to the gala held at the Barn at Paradise Station. Inauguration into this immersion begins as guests are encouraged to eavesdrop on several crucial conversations heard aboard their train car. Please ensure you arrive at the Strasburg Rail Road station 30 minutes prior to departure to ensure a smooth boarding experience. The train experience portion of this event is not ADA accessible. If you require ADA assistance, please call 717-687-8421 x147. A Night of Smoke & Silk Timeline: 5:00 Train Departure 5:45 – 6:00pm arrive at The Barn at Paradise for the Gala 6:00 – 6:30 Cocktails and Music 6:30 – 7:30pm Dinner & Drama 7:30 – 9:00pm Welcome Speech & More Drama 9:00 – 9:50pm – Dessert & Debrief with the cast. 9:50pm- Board the Train to return to the station. 10:00pm Train Departure from The Barn at Paradise Station Book your tickets now for the premiere of this immersive murder mystery experience! You don’t want to miss out!

events.title: Halloween Weekend Deal at Laserdome
events.description: Halloween Weekend at Laserdome Looking for Halloween fun that doesn’t depend on the weather? Laserdome in Manheim is taking $20 off its All Day Pass on Saturday, October 31 and Sunday, November 1. That drops the pass from $69.99 to $49.99 per person, so you can spend the holiday weekend on laser tag missions, holographic adventures and the arcade without watching the clock. What the All Day Pass includes Unlimited Laser Tag: play as many sessions as you want in a 9,000 square foot, two-level arena with fog and neon cover Unlimited Verse Immersive: walk through life-size holograms in an AR theater. There’s no VR headset, so you see your group the whole time Free Unlimited Arcade: included with every pass, a $24.99 value Don’t miss Trick r Treat: Laserdome’s holographic haunted house is part of the Verse lineup and fits the weekend perfectly. You walk through four spooky locations, and every candy you pick up and pumpkin you touch decides whether you make it out. Halloween weekend is one of Laserdome’s busiest times and sessions can sell out, so reserve ahead. Reservations come with a refundable deposit, and booking online gets every player 100 bonus prize points at check-in. Make a day of it: Add the pizza and drink package when you reserve online and save $5.49 per person. Trick-or-treating Saturday night? Come early in the day and still make it home in time. Know before you go. When: Saturday, October 31 and Sunday, November 1, 2026. events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.description: Come to Root’s Old Mill Flea Market and experience the thrill of discovering hidden treasures around every corner! events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Santa’s Paradise Express at Strasburg Rail Road
events.description: All board Santa’s Paradise Express! This Christmas season, ignite a new tradition or celebrate an old one with your family as you ride the rails at Strasburg Rail Road. Our daily Christmas trains include all the festivities that make the holidays special: Carolers and brass players bring you your all-time favorite carols, Santa’s helpers will gift your child a special gift from the North Pole, and your train ride even includes a visit from the big man himself, Santa Claus! This 45-minute train ride through the beautiful Amish countryside is certain to bring your family closer together and make your holiday season extra special! What to expect before arrival: You can check in at our station box office between platforms 3 & 4. Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes early, as the train will begin boarding 15 minutes before departure. Arrive even earlier to check out our live Christmas revue shows on the Town Square Stage at the heart of the station. All you need to bring with you is a big helping of holiday cheer, and even if you don’t, we’ll ensure you leave with some! Get your tickets now, we hope to see you here!

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.location: Unique Lancaster, 23 N Walnut Street, Lancaster, 17603

events.title: Night Before Christmas at Strasburg Rail Road
events.description: Join us at Strasburg Rail Road for a cozy evening tradition that has been around for almost 15 years and is certain to become a yearly ritual for your family as well! Our Night Before Christmas trains will put you in the holiday spirit as our talented cast recites the classic poem by Clement Clarke Moore as well as other festive Christmas stories. Your family will also be regaled by a troupe of carolers singing and dancing to a medley of your favorite Christmas carols. But the night would not be complete without the timeless combination of milk and cookies and perhaps even a glimpse of Santa Claus himself hurriedly preparing for his most important night of the year! You definitely don’t want to miss out on experiencing this special holiday train ride, so book your tickets now! What to expect upon arrival: Be sure to arrive at least 30 minutes early, as the train will begin boarding 15 minutes before departure. You can check in at our station box office between platforms 3 & 4. All aboard!

events.title: Root’s Old Mill Flea Market
events.description: Come to Root’s Old Mill Flea Market and experience the thrill of discovering hidden treasures around every corner! From vintage artwork and antique lamps to heirloom furniture and one-of-a-kind collectibles, you never know what you’ll find waiting for you at Root’s. Bring the whole family and enjoy browsing 175+ vendor stands offering a variety of antiques, collectibles, estate jewelry, household treasures, tools, decor, and so much more—indoors and outdoors. Interested in becoming a Flea Market vendor? Reservations are required for Tuesday market. Requests may be placed by calling (717) 898-7443 beginning at the end of market day (3pm on Tuesday) through Monday at 12 noon. Vendor spaces on Tuesday start at $20. Saturday Flea Market spaces are first come, first served. Only $10! Vendors who participate on Saturdays receive priority placement for Tuesdays. *Please mention if you’re bringing a trailer or large vehicle, so that we may better accommodate you. events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.

events.title: Lancaster Breakfast and History Walking Tour
events.description: Searching for a walking history tour in Lancaster? You’re in for a flavorful experience—literally! Introducing the Lancaster History & Breakfast Walking Tour—a dynamic two-hour adventure that blends the rich heritage of one of America’s oldest inland cities with a delicious morning meal. Explore Lancaster’s vibrant streets with a professionally trained local guide and journey through time from the early 1700s through the transformative decades of the 20th century. Brought to you by Unique Lancaster Experiences, this guided walk kicks off with your choice of hot or iced coffee or tea to energize your morning. Along the way, you’ll hear engaging stories about Lancaster’s evolution as a bustling Market City and its transition from trolleys to automobiles after WWI. But this isn’t your standard history tour. You’ll dive into interactive discussions and uncover captivating insights about colonial life, architectural landmarks, and the impact of prohibition on the region. As you explore, you’ll stop at five handpicked local spots to enjoy a curated tasting menu featuring hearty breakfast sandwiches, fresh fruits, sweet pastries, and other morning favorites. Please note: This tour offers vegetarian-friendly options only. If you have other dietary needs, we recommend our International Food Tour for a better fit. Whether you’re passionate about history, love discovering new flavors, or just want a memorable way to see the city, the Lancaster History & Breakfast Tour is a great choice for solo explorers, couples, and groups alike.
events.categories: Children & Family Events, Food & Beverage Events, Lancaster City, Tour
events.location: Unique Lancaster, 23 N Walnut Street, Lancaster, 17603

Follow inventive clues through Lancaster’s picturesque and historic downtown ???? Earn fun rewards as you complete challenges ???? Discover tucked-away gardens, arcades, historic markets, and more ???? Access special discounts at participating local businesses ⏱ Choose your pace—go head-to-head with friends or enjoy a leisurely journey ???? What Makes It Unforgettable? ????‍????‍????‍???? Great for everyone—couples, families, birthday celebrations, team events, or spontaneous outings ???? Hands-On & Entertaining—history comes to life through interactive games, not lectures ???? Creative Challenges—snap silly photos, solve riddles, and compete for glory ???? On-Call Help—first-time visitor? A friendly local guide is available if you need hints ???? Awesome Gift Idea—for Lancaster natives and curious newcomers alike ???? Getting Started Is Easy: 1.Reserve your tickets—just one per player 2.Check your email for download instructions 3.Watch a quick briefing video to get ready 4.Meet your team at the Welcome Center 5.Dive into a one-of-a-kind city experience! ???? Spots are limited—reserve yours today! Whether you’re exploring Lancaster for the first time or rediscovering its charm, this scavenger adventure will change how you see the city! *** Please note that some days offer multiple start times

events.title: Little Explorer and Me at North Museum
events.description: Sign up for an exciting, hands-on program where curiosity and learning come to life as Little Explorers and their grown ups experiment and discover together. Where curiosity and learning come to life as Little Explorers and their grown ups experiment and discover together. Every month, a trained facilitator guides you through a new theme that sparks your child’s imagination while helping build critical skills through fun and interactive play. Each activity is designed to be easy for you to recreate at home with everyday materials, giving your child the chance to explore and engage with the world around them. Whether it’s learning about the wonders of sound, exploring the colors of the rainbow, or discovering the magic of play, your child will gain valuable knowledge they can use in everyday life. events.title: Little Explorer and Me at North Museum
events.description: Sign up for an exciting, hands-on program where curiosity and learning come to life as Little Explorers and their grown ups experiment and discover together. Where curiosity and learning come to life as Little Explorers and their grown ups experiment and discover together. Every month, a trained facilitator guides you through a new theme that sparks your child’s imagination while helping build critical skills through fun and interactive play. Each activity is designed to be easy for you to recreate at home with everyday materials, giving your child the chance to explore and engage with the world around them. Whether it’s learning about the wonders of sound, exploring the colors of the rainbow, or discovering the magic of play, your child will gain valuable knowledge they can use in everyday life. PRE-REGISTER—We kindly ask that all register in advance of attending this program so our facilitator can prepare materials. Registrations do not grant access to the museum. events.title: Preschool Picassos at North Museum
events.description: Calling all parents and caregivers with preschool-aged children who love to create art! Happening the first Saturday of every month, Preschool Picassos provides young visitors with a unique art experience when we teach children various science-based techniques with their caregivers. As children experiment and explore, they will not only learn to be a part of the conversation around Science, Technology, Engineering, Art, and Math (STEAM), but they will create some unique works of art along the way! Facilitator Marilyn Zenko has a background in STEM as an archeologist and is currently a Senior Client Development Specialist at Terracon. Enter with General Admission. $13 each. Free for Members. events.title: Root’s Old Mill Flea Market
events.description: Come to Root’s Old Mill Flea Market and experience the thrill of discovering hidden treasures around every corner! From vintage artwork and antique lamps to heirloom furniture and one-of-a-kind collectibles, you never know what you’ll find waiting for you at Root’s. Bring the whole family and enjoy browsing 175+ vendor stands offering a variety of antiques, collectibles, estate jewelry, household treasures, tools, decor, and so much more—indoors and outdoors. Interested in becoming a Flea Market vendor? Reservations are required for Tuesday market. Requests may be placed by calling (717) 898-7443 beginning at the end of market day (3pm on Tuesday) through Monday at 12 noon. Vendor spaces on Tuesday start at $20. Saturday Flea Market spaces are first come, first served. Only $10! Vendors who participate on Saturdays receive priority placement for Tuesdays. *Please mention if you’re bringing a trailer or large vehicle, so that we may better accommodate you. Be sure to check our calendar of events to confirm Root’s Saturday Flea Market dates and times. Additional Shopping & Fun Things To Do in Lancaster? Bring the whole family and enjoy browsing 175+ vendor stands offering a variety of antiques, collectibles, estate jewelry, household treasures, tools, decor, and so much more—indoors and outdoors. Interested in becoming a Flea Market vendor? Reservations are required for Tuesday market. Requests may be placed by calling (717) 898-7443 beginning at the end of market day (3pm on Tuesday) through Monday at 12 noon. Vendor spaces on Tuesday start at $20. Saturday Flea Market spaces are first come, first served. Only $10! Vendors who participate on Saturdays receive priority placement for Tuesdays. *Please mention if you’re bringing a trailer or large vehicle, so that we may better accommodate you. Be sure to check our calendar of events to confirm Root’s Saturday Flea Market dates and times. Additional Shopping & Fun Things To Do in Lancaster? events.description: Come to Root’s Old Mill Flea Market and experience the thrill of discovering hidden treasures around every corner! From vintage artwork and antique lamps to heirloom furniture and one-of-a-kind collectibles, you never know what you’ll find waiting for you at Root’s. Bring the whole family and enjoy browsing 175+ vendor stands offering a variety of antiques, collectibles, estate jewelry, household treasures, tools, decor, and so much more—indoors and outdoors. Interested in becoming a Flea Market vendor? Reservations are required for Tuesday market. Requests may be placed by calling (717) 898-7443 beginning at the end of market day (3pm on Tuesday) through Monday at 12 noon. Vendor spaces on Tuesday start at $20. Saturday Flea Market spaces are first come, first served. Only $10! Vendors who participate on Saturdays receive priority placement for Tuesdays. *Please mention if you’re bringing a trailer or large vehicle, so that we may better accommodate you. Be sure to check our calendar of events to confirm Root’s Saturday Flea Market dates and times. Additional Shopping & Fun Things To Do in Lancaster?
